name: Jack Photographs the Town in Sunlight
description: Jack moves through the town, raising his camera to capture the medieval buildings, the open square, and the church. The sun blazes overhead, casting sharp light across the stone facades as he adjusts his lens and takes each photograph.
related_events: Jack photographs medieval architecture and surrounding sights

name: Jack Decides to Proceed with Caution
description: Jack lowers his binoculars, stands still for a moment, then moves forward slowly, taking care with each step.
related_events: Jack lowers his binoculars and decides to proceed with caution

name: Jack Arrives at the Deserted Town Square
description: Jack drove to the town square, guided the car to a stop near the open area, and turned off the engine. He opened the door, stepped out, and stood beside the vehicle. The market stalls were gone, leaving the square bare and exposed.
related_events: Jack parks car near town square and exits vehicle

name: Jack Packs His Belongings
description: Jack gathers a few personal items and places them into a holdall.
related_events: Jack packs belongings into a holdall

name: Falcon Hovers Above Town at Dusk
description: The sun sinks below the horizon as a falcon hovers in the wind above the town, wings steady against the evening air. The bird scans the ground below, circling slowly, its eyes fixed on the shadows lengthening across the streets and rooftops.
related_events: Falcon hovers in the wind searching for prey

name: Jack Watches the Post Office Van Through Binoculars
description: Jack raises his binoculars and scans the alpine road. A small yellow and blue Italian post office van comes into view, moving slowly along the winding path toward Castelvecchio. He follows its progress as it climbs the road, the vehicle bobbing in and out of sight between the curves and patches of trees.
related_events: Jack observes a post office van through binoculars

name: Jack Arrives at the Bed and Breakfast
description: Jack walks through the medieval old town, making his way to a small family-run bed and breakfast just off the main square. The building bears a sign that reads 'PENSIONE ABRUZZO'. He comes to a stop in front of it.
related_events: Jack approaches a family-run bed and breakfast in the medieval old town

name: Jack Stops at the Crossroads
description: Jack stops the car at a crossroads. A signpost stands at the intersection, pointing toward a town. The sign reads: CASTELVECCHIO.
related_events: Jack stops the car at a crossroads
Signpost indicates direction to Castelvecchio

name: Jack Prepares for the Operation at Castel del Monte
description: Jack sat with his laptop open, arranging photographs of Castel del Monte into folders labeled by street plans and exit routes, separating those accessible by car from those on foot. The screen cast a pale glow on his face as he worked methodically. Nearby, his Walther PPK/S lay disassembled on a cloth. He wiped each piece with a lint-free rag, applied a thin coat of oil, and reassembled the firearm with steady hands.
related_events: Jack organizes photographs of Castel del Monte on laptop
Jack cleans and oils his Walther PPK/S

name: Jack Scans Castelvecchio with Binoculars
description: Jack pulls a pair of Leica 15x56 Geovid BRF rangefinding binoculars from his holdall. He stands at the casement window and begins scanning the town of Castelvecchio, moving the binoculars in a steady, grid-like pattern across the view. The town remains still. Occasionally, an old man, a woman, or a dog appears, but otherwise the streets are empty. Jack continues his observation without interruption.
related_events: Jack retrieves binoculars from his holdall
Jack conducts a methodical visual sweep of Castelvecchio

name: Jack Exits Supermarket and Turns Down Dark Side Street
description: Jack walks out of the supermarket carrying two bags of groceries. He turns quickly onto a dark side street.
related_events: Jack exits supermarket with groceries
Jack turns down dark side street

name: Jack Repairs the API Three-Wheeler and Father Benedetto Starts the Engine
description: Father Benedetto sat in the driver's seat of the API three-wheeler, the open bonnet revealing the engine where Jack worked. In the back of the vehicle, a mass of snakes writhed. Jack tinkered with the engine components, then gave a signal. Father Benedetto turned the ignition key; the engine sputtered but did not start. Jack made another adjustment and gestured again. Father Benedetto turned the key once more. The engine roared to life. He clapped his hands and cheered.
related_events: Jack attempts to repair the API three-wheeler engine
API three-wheeler engine successfully starts after repair attempt
Father Benedetto reacts with joy to the vehicle starting

name: Jack Notices the Modelling Agency Sign and Sees Clara Enter
description: Jack walks past a residential apartment block and sees a small, inconspicuous sign for a modelling agency. The sign's graphics are subtly lewd. At the same moment, a twenty-four-year-old Italian woman named Clara enters the building. She catches Jack's eye, and he continues walking.
related_events: Jack notices lewd modelling agency sign on residential building
Clara enters apartment building and catches Jack's attention

name: Jack Washes His Face and Stares at His Reflection
description: Jack stands in the cramped bathroom at the back of the bar, splashing water on his face. He grabs a towel and dries off, then lifts his head to look into the mirror. His reflection shows a face worn down by fatigue. He remains still, staring, as the sound of The White Stripes’ cover of One More Cup of Coffee plays faintly from the bar.
related_events: Jack washes his face in the bar's bathroom
Jack stares at his reflection in the mirror

name: Jack Glances at the Alabaster Statue
description: Jack crosses the courtyard and glances at the alabaster statue of a girl in a toga holding a clam shell. Water flows from the shell into the marble fountain below. He stops looking away, his gaze fixed on the figure.
related_events: Jack glances at the alabaster statue in the courtyard
Jack finds it hard to tear his eyes away from the statue

name: Priest Watches Jack Taking Photographs
description: The priest stands at the church above the town, watching the people below. Among the locals and scattered tourists, one man draws his attention. The man, Jack, moves through the town with deliberate precision, taking photographs in a strict, grid-like pattern. While others wander casually, Jack's methodical approach sets him apart. The priest observes him closely, his gaze fixed on the solitary figure.
related_events: Priest observes the town and its visitors
Jack systematically photographs the town

name: Jack kills the second hunter and reloads
description: Outside the dacha, a man stands by a black Mercedes-Benz sedan, holding an automatic pistol. Jack approaches and shoots him in the ear. The man falls. Jack removes the clip from his Walther, reloads it, and prepares to move on.
related_events: Jack shoots the second hunter with a bullet in the ear
Jack reloads the clip of his Walther pistol

name: Jack passes the rubbish bins and reveals his hidden car
description: Jack walks at a leisurely pace past a row of municipal rubbish bins located just inside the fortified gates of the old town. As he moves forward, his car comes into view, hidden behind the bins.
related_events: Jack passes municipal rubbish bins near fortified gates
Jack's car is revealed hidden behind rubbish bins

name: Jack Lies Awake with Concealed Handgun
description: Jack lies on his bed, fully clothed, staring awake into the dim room. Above him, taped to the underside of the wooden bed frame, is his Walther semi-automatic handgun.
related_events: Jack lies awake on his bed
Jack's handgun is concealed under the bed frame

name: Jack Faces the Barking Mongrel
description: A mangy dog tied to a post snarls and lunges at Jack, barking wildly, its fangs bared. The leash snaps tight, stopping the animal just short of reaching him. Jack stands motionless, watching the dog thrash and growl, its fur bristling with rage and fear. The two remain locked in silence, the dog straining against the rope, Jack unmoving, his eyes fixed on the animal.
related_events: Mongrel barks savagely at Jack while restrained by leash
Jack stares at the barking mongrel

name: Jack's Car Ascends to the Hilltop Town
description: Jack's car winds up a narrow mountain road, climbing steadily toward a remote Italian hilltop town. The town's medieval towers and slanted rooftops come into view, perched beneath an old stone castle. Snow-capped peaks rise in the distance. As the car nears, a church bell tolls, its sound echoing across the empty streets and stone walls.
related_events: Jack's car travels up winding mountain road toward hilltop town
Church bell tolls in desolate hilltop town

name: Jack Watches the Post Office and Leaves
description: Jack sits in a cafe across from a small rural Poste Italiane branch, quietly watching the entrance. He remains there for an hour, during which no one enters or leaves the building. He glances at his watch, then places the exact amount of change on the table. He stands up and prepares to leave.
related_events: Jack waits at the cafe while watching the post office entrance
Jack checks his watch after an hour of waiting
Jack leaves money on the table and stands up

name: Jack Observes Castelvecchio from the Ramparts
description: Jack sits at a small table outside a bar in Castel del Monte, wearing dark glasses and sipping a coffee while reading a guidebook. He finishes his drink, closes the book, and places some money on the table. He stands, adjusts his jacket, and walks away from the bar. Passing through the narrow streets, he reaches the town ramparts and steps up to the parapet. From there, he looks out across the valley toward the abandoned fortress of Castelvecchio, standing silent and still in the distance.
related_events: Jack finishes coffee and departs from bar in Castel del Monte
Jack observes deserted Castelvecchio from town ramparts

name: Jack Sabotages the Mercedes and Flees in the Saab
description: Jack smashes the CB radio in the Mercedes and takes the distributor cap from the engine, burying it deep in the snow. He then gets into the Saab and drives away. He travels on a ferry to Gotland, changes clothes and switches vehicles, continues by road to Trelleborg, takes the night ferry to Travemünde, drives to Hamburg, and from there boards a train heading onward.
related_events: Jack destroys the CB radio in the Mercedes
Jack removes the distributor cap from the Mercedes engine
Jack enters the Saab
Jack drives away from the scene

name: Jack Wakes to the Sound of a Falling Book
description: Jack lies on his bed, fully clothed, asleep with a book in his hand. His fingers twitch, loosening their grip, and the book slips from his grasp, falling to the floor with a thud. The noise jolts him awake. He sits up sharply, reaches under the bed, and pulls out a taped Walther pistol, aiming it at the door.
related_events: Jack falls asleep on his bed while holding a book
Jack's book slips from his hand and falls to the floor
Jack wakes up and grabs his taped Walther pistol

name: Father Benedetto Cooks a Meal While Jack Observes
description: In a sixteenth-century room with dark wood panelling and paraffin lamps casting a soft glow, Father Benedetto moves about a wood-fired stove, preparing a meal with antique crockery and old copper pots. The thick oak dining table stands nearby, heavy and silent. As he works, transforming raw ingredients into food, he hums fragments of opera arias and Johnny Cash songs. He pauses occasionally to sip wine from a glass at his side, then returns to stirring, chopping, and tending the fire. Jack sits at the table, watching, slowly drinking wine from his own glass. The air fills with the scent of cooking, the quiet clink of utensils, and the low murmur of music and flame.
related_events: Father Benedetto prepares a meal using antique cooking implements
Father Benedetto hums opera arias and Johnny Cash songs while cooking
Father Benedetto sips wine while cooking
Jack sips wine while observing Father Benedetto cook

name: Jack's Morning Routine
description: Jack finishes his morning exercises, then steps into the shower and dresses afterward. He moves with precision, methodically going through each task. Once ready, he picks up his binoculars and looks through the medieval casement window, scanning the town of Castelvecchio.
related_events: Jack completes morning exercises
Jack showers and dresses

name: Jack Observes Castelvecchio Through Binoculars
description: Jack finishes his morning exercises, showers, and dresses with precise, methodical movements. Once ready, he picks up a pair of binoculars and stands at his medieval casement window, looking out over the nearby town of Castelvecchio. He studies the town through the lenses, moving them slowly across the rooftops and streets.
related_events: Jack studies Castelvecchio with binoculars

name: Jack Disposes of Phone from Moving Car
description: Jack's car leaves Castelvecchio and moves swiftly across a high viaduct that stretches over a deep ravine. The driver's window slides down, and a mobile phone wrapped in a cellophane bag is hurled from the car. The phone tumbles through the air, falling hundreds of feet before disappearing into the ravine below.
related_events: Car exits Castelvecchio
Car crosses viaduct over ravine
Driver opens window and throws phone from car
Phone falls into ravine

name: Jack Receives Intel from Larry and Voices Concerns
description: Jack stands in the town square, scanning his surroundings as Larry's voice comes through. Larry confirms the source in Rome is clean, with no organized crime ties, and explains the exchange was a simple favor arranged through a corrupt contact in NOCS who provided the Socimi. Jack remarks that he hopes the payment was low, warning that higher payments increase the chance of police talking in the locker rooms. On the other side of the square, Father Benedetto waves at Jack, who watches him silently.
related_events: Larry reports on the source in Rome
Jack expresses concern about overpayment leading to police gossip

name: Jack Scans the Square, Notices Father Benedetto
description: Jack moves through the town square with quiet vigilance, eyes sweeping the area. Across the open space, Father Benedetto raises a hand and waves in his direction. Jack sees the gesture and acknowledges it without response, his posture unchanged.
related_events: Jack scans the town square with caution
Father Benedetto waves at Jack from across the square

name: Tourists Gather at the Central Piazza Market
description: The central piazza buzzes with activity as the local market fills the square with stalls selling food, produce, clothes, and cheap CDs. Tourists move between the stands, browsing and chatting, their presence adding to the energy of the once-quiet town. Near a phone box by a cheese vendor, a woman in dark glasses rummages through her handbag, a rolled copy of Il Messaggero tucked under her arm, its front page folded in half.
related_events: Market attracts tourists to the town
related_occasions: Local Market In The Central Piazza

name: Woman Searches Handbag by Cheese Stall
description: In the central piazza, amid the bustle of the market, an attractive woman stands near a phone box beside a cheese stall. She holds a folded copy of Il Messaggero under her right arm and rifles through her handbag, searching for something.
related_events: Woman searches her handbag near a cheese stall
related_occasions: Local Market In The Central Piazza

name: Jack Finds a Hidden Envelope with False Identity Documents
description: Jack gets into a compact Citroen C2 and reaches for the glove compartment. He opens it and pulls out a plain manila envelope. Inside, he finds a passport in the name of Edward Clarke with his own photo, a driver's license also in the name of Edward Clarke, and a map. He looks at the documents without reacting, then holds them in his hands as the car sits silent around him.
related_events: Jack enters a compact Citroen C2
Jack opens the glove compartment of the car
Jack discovers a plain manilla envelope in the glove compartment
Jack finds a passport in the name of Edward Clarke with his photo
Jack finds a driver's license in the name of Edward Clarke
Jack finds a map inside the envelope

name: Jack Buys Cheese and Finds the Woman at the Cafe
description: Jack stands at a market stall and buys a piece of cheese, pointing to the one he wants and asking for pecorino as well. He pays the old woman running the stall, then looks around. Twenty meters away, he sees a woman sitting outside a cafe, talking on her cellphone. He begins to walk toward the cafe.
related_events: Jack buys cheese at a market stall
Jack glances around looking for the woman

name: Jack Moves Toward the Woman at the Cafe
description: Jack buys a piece of cheese from the old woman's stall, folds his newspaper, and walks toward the cafe. The woman sits at an outdoor table twenty meters away, speaking on her cellphone. He approaches the cafe as she continues her conversation.
related_events: Jack approaches cafe after purchasing cheese
Woman talks on cellphone at outdoor cafe

name: Jack Observes the Silent Town
description: Jack looks at the sign and up at the quiet town, its vast stone ramparts looming above. An old man steps out of a crooked medieval doorway, stares at Jack, then disappears into another building. Jack gazes at the dark, empty windows scattered beneath the sagging, patchwork roofs. A dog barks. The wind hisses through the streets. Jack turns and drives away.
related_events: Jack observes the silent town and its decaying structures
Wind hisses through the deserted town
Dog barks in the quiet town
Old man emerges from medieval doorway and vanishes

name: Jack Leaves the Town
description: Jack stands before the sign, then looks up at the silent town, its vast stone ramparts looming above. An old man steps out of a crooked medieval doorway, stares at Jack, and vanishes into another building. Jack gazes at the dark, empty window sockets and the sagging, patchwork roofs. A dog barks. The wind hisses through the streets. Jack turns, gets into his vehicle, and drives away.
related_events: Jack makes a decision to leave
Jack drives away from the town

name: Jack Receives a Job Offer at a Pay Phone
description: Jack stands at a pay phone in the town square, scanning the area as he speaks. Larry's voice comes through the receiver, asking why Jack hasn't been reachable and mentioning the secure cell phone he provided. Jack replies quietly, saying he forgot to mention his electromagnetic hypersensitivity. Larry tells him he has a new job—one that doesn't require pulling a trigger. Jack asks who the client is. Larry assures him the woman is trustworthy and will come to him. Jack resists, saying the town is too small, that he grew up in one, and that he's already drawing attention. Larry counters that anyone trying to kill Jack would also be drawn to him, no matter where he is. Jack lights a cigarette. Larry reminds him that he cleaned up his past messes and made him disappear, and that Jack owes him twenty percent plus the first payment—after this job, he'll be free. Jack stands silently, turning the offer over in his mind.
related_events: Jack uses a local pay phone to receive a call from Larry
Jack reveals his electromagnetic hypersensitivity to avoid using cell phones
Larry assigns Jack a new job over the phone
Jack lights a cigarette during the phone conversation

name: Jack Considers the Word 'Free'
description: After Larry tells Jack the job will make him free, Jack stands quietly, turning the word over in his mind. He stares off, silent, as the conversation ends, the weight of the word lingering in the air.
related_events: Jack turns over the word 'free' in thought after Larry's statement

name: Jack and Ingrid Reunite by the Fire
description: Jack sits by the dying fire, whiskey in hand, his gaze fixed on the embers. A creak behind him draws his attention. Without turning fully, he senses movement. Ingrid steps close, barefoot and naked, and presses a kiss to the top of his head. She settles behind him, sliding her arms around his chest, her hands linking just above his heart. Her cheek rests against his shoulder, her face beside his. They say nothing. The fire flickers, casting shifting light across their bodies as they sit together in silence.
related_events: Jack notices a creak behind him
Ingrid kisses Jack on the top of his head
Ingrid sits close behind Jack and wraps her arms around him
Ingrid and Jack watch the fire together in silence

name: Jack Sits by the Dying Fire
description: Jack sits alone in the dim glow of a fading log fire, the embers casting soft light across the room. He holds a thick-cut crystal glass of whiskey, sipping slowly. The silver in his hair and stubble catches the low light, and the US Army Special Forces tattoo on his bare shoulder stands out against his skin. He stares into the fire, motionless, as the quiet settles around him.
related_events: Jack sips whiskey by the dying fire

name: Clara undresses and lies down on the bed
description: Clara enters the room and sits on the edge of the bed, which creaks under her weight. She places her cigarette in the ashtray on the bedside table, kicks off her shoes, slips off her panties, and pulls her light cotton dress over her head in one smooth motion. She lies back on the bed.
related_events: Clara enters the room and sits on the bed
Clara places cigarette in ashtray
Clara removes her shoes, panties, and dress
Clara lies back on the bed

name: Jack Sits Beside Clara and She Reaches for Him
description: Jack sits on the bed beside Clara without looking at her. She says, 'Amore?', and reaches up to touch him just as the scene ends.
related_events: Jack sits beside Clara on the bed
Clara reaches up to touch Jack

name: Larry and Jack Reunite in Rome
description: At a fast food stand near the central train station in Rome, Larry squeezes ketchup onto a hotdog. The autumn air is crisp, and the usual summer crowds are gone. Jack approaches, an American who stands out in the quiet streets. Larry sees him but keeps his attention on the hotdog, masking his surprise. He takes a careful bite, avoiding mess. Jack speaks first, saying he closed the Stockholm account. Larry listens without reacting, then turns and begins to walk, eating steadily. Jack falls into step beside him. As they move, Jack adds that there were complications—collateral damage, two shooters, unidentified, and a girl. Larry glances sideways, finishes his hotdog, and points across the street to a bar called L'Aquila. He tells Jack to go inside, freshen up, wait, and give him two hours. Then he continues walking.
related_events: Larry applies ketchup to a hotdog at a fast food stand
Larry encounters Jack in Rome and feigns disinterest
Jack reveals closure of the Stockholm account
Jack discloses complications related to the Stockholm account closure

name: Jack Reports the Aftermath, Larry Sets the Next Move
description: Jack tells Larry about the two unidentified shooters and a girl caught in the crossfire. They walk together down the street, both scanning their surroundings with quiet alertness. Larry takes a bite of his hot dog, careful not to get his hands dirty, then gestures across the road. He tells Jack to go to the bar L'Aquila, clean up, and wait there for two hours.
related_events: Jack reports presence of two unidentified shooters and a girl as collateral damage
Larry begins walking while eating his hotdog
Jack walks alongside Larry while both remain vigilant
Larry suggests Jack go to the L'Aquila bar to wait for two hours

name: Ingrid and Jack Walk to the Frozen Lake
description: Ingrid leads Jack through the trees, her coat fluttering with a white fur collar. The forest is thick with snow, silent and still beneath the heavy blanket. They move toward a vast frozen lake, their faces fresh and warm from bed. As they walk, Jack slows, glancing into the darkness beneath the conifers. He looks around, tense. Ingrid turns to him. 'What are you looking for?' she asks, her Swedish accent light. 'Nothing,' Jack says. He forces a smile as they continue forward.
related_events: Ingrid leads Jack through the trees toward a frozen lake
Jack senses something in the woods and becomes anxious

name: Ingrid Reassures Jack in the Snow
description: Ingrid notices Jack looking around nervously as they walk through the snow-covered woods. She stops and asks, "What are you looking for?" Jack glances toward the dark trees beneath the conifers, then shakes his head. "Nothing," he says. Ingrid laughs, the sound clear in the still air. "There are no wolves in the woods so close to the city," she says, her voice light. Jack looks at her, then smiles faintly, his shoulders relaxing.
related_events: Ingrid questions Jack about what he is looking for
Jack denies seeing anything despite his anxiety
Ingrid laughs and reassures Jack there are no wolves nearby

name: Jack Smiles After Ingrid's Reassurance
description: Ingrid laughs and tells Jack there are no wolves in the woods so close to the city. Jack smiles.
related_events: Jack smiles after Ingrid's reassurance

name: Sipping Brandy at Dusk
description: The sun sank behind the high mountains overlooking the hilltop town. Jack sat in a small walled garden at the rear of a crumbling fifteenth-century building, the last rays of light still warming the stones. Father Benedetto poured two large glasses of Armagnac from a globular green bottle. He lifted his glass, sniffed the drink deeply, and murmured, "Que siamo!" Jack brought his glass to his nose, sniffed cautiously, then took a small sip.
related_events: Sun sets behind the mountains overlooking the hilltop town
Father Benedetto pours two glasses of Armagnac
Jack cautiously sniffs and sips his brandy

name: Father Benedetto and Jack Discuss History and National Character
description: Father Benedetto pours two glasses of Armagnac from a green bottle and sniffs his drink, then offers a sharp critique of French culture, calling the French arrogant sensualists and dismissing their cuisine and wine, though he concedes their brandy is worthy. He switches to English, apologizes for speaking too quickly, and asks Jack if he has studied Italian history. When Jack says no, Father Benedetto looks horrified. He remarks that Jack, as an American, must believe he can escape history, living only for the present. Jack takes a sip of his brandy and says he tries to.
related_events: Father Benedetto criticizes French culture and cuisine
Father Benedetto expresses shock at Jack's lack of interest in history
Father Benedetto apologizes for speaking too fast
Father Benedetto comments on American detachment from history

name: Jack Sips Brandy and Speaks of Living in the Present
description: The sun sinks behind the mountains as Jack and Father Benedetto sit in the walled garden, each holding a glass of Armagnac. After the priest criticizes the French and comments on Americans escaping history, Jack takes a sip of his drink and says, 'I try to, father.'
related_events: Jack acknowledges his effort to live in the present

name: Jack Requests His Mail
description: Jack enters the small, dusty shop and greets the postmaster with a 'Buon giorno.' The postmaster grunts in reply, jutting his chin. Jack asks about his general delivery mail. The postmaster turns to the rack of pigeonholes behind the counter and, without speaking, gestures for Jack's surname. Jack tells him, 'Clarke.'
related_events: Jack greets the postmaster with a morning salutation
Postmaster responds to Jack with a grunt and chin gesture
Jack inquires about his general delivery mail
Postmaster asks for Jack's surname
Jack provides his surname as Clarke

name: Jack Receives a Package from the Postmaster
description: The postmaster turns to a rack of pigeonholes behind a sack of mail and pulls a bundle of envelopes from one slot, flipping through them with thin, practiced fingers. He mutters 'Clarky?' and Jack corrects him—'Clarke.' The postmaster makes a clicking sound and disappears behind the rack, then returns with a package wrapped in brown paper, marked by the name of an Italian photographic supplier. Jack nods his thanks. The postmaster holds out his hand for identification. Jack slides his passport across the counter. The postmaster picks it up, studies the photograph, and looks up at Jack’s face, holding the gaze. Jack does not move or speak, his expression unchanged.
related_events: Postmaster retrieves mail from a pigeonhole rack
Postmaster flips through mail with practiced motion
Postmaster locates a package for Jack Clarke

Jack maintains composed demeanor during identity check

name: Jack Reaches the Four-Way Alleyway Crossroads
description: Jack walks down a narrow alleyway lined with arches and flying stone buttresses, the path twisting with blind corners and steep inclines. The alley bends repeatedly, enclosed by ancient walls and outdoor stairwells, until it opens into a junction where four narrow alleyways meet. Jack stops at the convergence, then turns to face each passage, photographing them one by one.
related_events: Jack walks through a narrow alleyway with multiple blind corners and arches
Jack reaches a crossroads where four alleyways converge

name: Jack Photographs the Crossroads
description: Jack reaches the intersection where four narrow alleyways meet. He takes out his camera and photographs each passage, capturing the steep uphill and downhill routes. From an upstairs window, the sound of a game show drifts down through the alley. Somewhere nearby, a dog barks, though no animal is in sight. The noise grows louder as Jack turns and walks back the way he came. On his right, he notices a narrow crack between two ancient stone walls, barely wide enough to pass through. He steps through the gap and enters a courtyard beyond.
related_events: Jack photographs each of the four alleyways at the crossroads
Television game show audio plays from an upstairs window
A dog barks from another alleyway with no visible source

name: Jack Hears Barking, Returns, and Finds a Hidden Archway
description: Jack turns around and walks back the way he came. The sound of the barking dog grows louder. On his right, he notices a narrow crack between two ancient stone walls, partially hidden by their overlapping structure. The gap is slim, resembling an archer's slit, but wide enough for a person to pass through. Jack studies it, then slips through the opening. On the other side, he enters a courtyard.
related_events: Jack turns around and walks back the way he came
Jack discovers a hidden archway resembling an archer's slit

name: Jack Enters the Hidden Courtyard
description: Jack steps through a narrow gap between two overlapping ancient stone walls, slipping from the alleyway into a secluded courtyard. The opening, barely wide enough for a person, is hidden in the angle where the stones converge. He passes through and finds himself inside.
related_events: Jack slips through the hidden archway into a courtyard

name: Jack's Attempt to Buy Cigarettes from a Malfunctioning Machine
description: Jack inserts coins into a cigarette machine. The machine takes the money but does not dispense the cigarettes. He presses the refund button, but nothing happens. Jack checks the time, then strikes the machine with his hand.
related_events: Jack inserts coins into cigarette machine
Cigarette machine fails to dispense product
Jack presses refund button with no result
Jack checks the time and strikes the machine

name: Jack Meets Father Benedetto at the Cigarette Machine
description: Jack hears footsteps approaching. He straightens his posture and glances at his watch. A man appears behind him, reflected in the surface of Jack's worn Rolex. Jack turns to face him, offering a polite smile. The man, a priest in a frayed Roman collar, returns the smile. 'Can I help you?' he asks. Jack shakes his head slightly. The priest introduces himself with quiet confidence, noting Jack is American and staying at Pensione Arbruzzo. Jack confirms he’s on a working vacation, a photographer documenting the region’s architecture and landscapes. The priest presses gently, asking about people, then about which magazine Jack works for. Jack explains it’s a syndicate supplying various publications. Without pause, the priest invites him to share a glass of wine that evening, saying a priest sees everything.
related_events: Jack notices footsteps and adjusts his stance
Father Benedetto approaches and offers assistance
Jack turns and exchanges greetings with Father Benedetto

name: Father Benedetto Questions Jack About His Work
description: Jack stands by a cigarette machine that has taken his coins without dispensing cigarettes or providing a refund. He checks the time and strikes the machine. Footsteps approach, and in the reflection of his worn Rolex, Jack sees a man behind him. He turns to face Father Benedetto, a priest in a poorly fitting black suit with a frayed Roman collar. The priest smiles and asks if he can help. Father Benedetto remarks that Jack is American, speaking matter-of-factly. Jack confirms it with a simple 'Si.' The priest then asks if Jack speaks Italian, and Jack replies 'Poco.' Father Benedetto says it's fine and adds that Jack is staying at Pensione Arbruzzo, a statement that catches Jack off guard, though he shows little reaction. Jack says he won’t be staying much longer. The priest asks if he is on vacation, and Jack replies it’s a working vacation. When asked about his work, Jack says he is a photographer. Father Benedetto wants to know what kind of photography. Jack says he takes pictures of the region—architecture, landscapes. The priest asks if he photographs people. Jack says no, only sights and landmarks, for guidebooks and magazines. Father Benedetto presses, asking which magazine. Jack explains it’s a syndicate supplying many publications, mentioning 'Casa editrice.' The priest then invites Jack to share a glass of wine that evening, saying a priest sees everything.
related_events: Father Benedetto identifies Jack as American and guesses his lodging

name: Jack Assembles the SOCIMI 821 Sub-Machine Gun
description: Jack opens the package and removes several items: film, photographic paper, development fluids, and fixing solutions. He continues pulling out a solid, monolithic rectangular receiver made of lightweight alloy, a bolt assembly, and finally a barrel. With the barrel in hand, he places all the components on the floor, where they form a complete set. The SOCIMI 821 sub-machine gun lies fully assembled in its parts. Jack studies the weapon without touching it, noting the scratched-off serial number. He then begins to assemble it with precise, practiced movements: inserting the barrel into the receiver and securing it with the nut, unfolding the tubular stock and locking the buttpad into place, bringing the weapon to his shoulder, sighting down the barrel, and slowly squeezing the finger-grooved trigger.

name: Larry Meets Jack at the Bar and Delivers the Envelope
description: Larry enters the bar and sits down across from Jack. He looks at Jack with genuine surprise and says, 'You started smoking again?' Jack exhales smoke and replies, 'Guess so.' Larry asks, 'Since when?' Jack answers, 'Since now.' The waiter approaches, flicks a cloth over the table, and asks if they want coffee. Larry says, 'Due.' The waiter leaves. After a pause, Larry places an envelope on the table and says, 'Stockholm account. Final installment.' Jack takes the envelope and slips it into an inside pocket of his jacket. The waiter returns and sets two cups of coffee on the table.

name: Larry Delivers Escape Instructions
description: The waiter returns and sets two cups of coffee on the table. Larry drops two sugar cubes into his cup and stirs. Leaning forward, he speaks in a low, fast voice, warning Jack that he is in immediate danger and must hide nearby to avoid being seen. He tells Jack to turn right after leaving the bar, then take the second left onto Via Spinetti, where he will find a silver Citroen C2 with Chieti license plates. Jack should check the glove box and follow the map inside to Castelvecchio—a remote, isolated place with few people around. Larry slides a mobile phone wrapped in a cellophane bag across the table. He tells Jack to get to the location, stay there, and wait for his call before taking any further action.

name: Jack and the Motorcyclist on Via Romana
description: A man on a 1970s Ducati turns down the narrow alleyway and drives toward Jack. Jack begins walking faster. As the motorcycle closes in, he slips his right hand into his pocket. When the bike is two meters away, a loud bang rings out. Jack drops to his knees. A second bang follows—the Ducati backfiring twice. Kneeling, Jack remains still for a moment, then bends down and pretends to tie his right shoelace. The motorcyclist continues up the alley, stops outside an apartment, and gets off the bike.

description: The man on the Ducati stopped outside an apartment, turned off his bike, and removed his helmet. He looked over at Jack and called out, 'Buon giorno!' Jack replied, 'Buon giorno.' The man asked, 'Da dove provenite?' Jack hesitated slightly before answering, 'America.' The man smiled and said, 'Ah! L'Americano!' Jack nodded. 'Si. Il Americano.' The man laughed, repeating, 'L'Americano! L'Americano!' with emphasis. From inside the apartment, a woman's voice shouted angrily. The man turned, yelled back through the doorway, then stepped inside and slammed the door. Jack continued walking down the alley.

name: Crossing the Frozen Lake
description: Ingrid steps onto the ice at the edge of the lake and holds out her hand. Jack takes it. They walk together across the frozen surface, the ice solid beneath their feet. Ingrid slips and laughs. Jack stumbles, swearing, then begins to relax. They move forward, side by side, leaving footprints in the thin snow that covers the ice, the winter landscape still and bright around them.

name: Footprints on the Ice and a Falling Branch
description: Ingrid and Jack step onto the frozen lake, their boots crunching in the thin snow. Jack stops suddenly, crouching to examine tracks pressed into the ice. A set of small, delicate prints leads out across the lake—those of a snow-hare. Beside them, larger footprints mark the path of a man, but they are heading in the opposite direction, back toward the shore. Jack scans the tree line, then spins around. A low branch near the edge of the lake trembles, and a thick clump of snow drops silently to the ground.

name: Jack Reacts to Gunfire and Locates the Shooter
description: After a gunshot cracks through the air, Jack grabs Ingrid and yanks her toward the cover of the lakeside trees, pushing her down into the snow. He lies beside her, pulls a Walther PPK/S from his parka, and cocks the weapon. Another shot rings out—quiet, sharp. Jack scans the tree line and catches a faint drift of blue smoke curling from the shadows beneath the trees. He fixes his gaze on the spot, snow rubbing off his woolen hat as he edges up and fires three shots into the dusk. A groan follows, then the sound of something sliding through the snow.

Jack fumbles with the man's buttons, searching through his clothing until he pulls a military identity pass from the breast pocket. He looks at it and says the man is a hunter.

description: Ingrid gasped, her breath catching in the cold air as she stared at the gun in Jack's hand. 'You have a gun,' she whispered, then louder, 'You have a gun! How do you have a gun? Why should you carry such a weapon?' Jack did not answer. His eyes stayed fixed on the tree line, scanning the shadows beneath the snow-laden branches. After a moment, he turned slightly, his voice low and firm. 'Go for help. Call the police.' Ingrid hesitated, wide-eyed, then turned and began to stumble up the track they had made through the snow.

name: Jack and Mathilde's Coded Meeting at the Cafe
description: Jack sits at a table beside a woman who finishes a phone call in English. As she places her phone back into her handbag, she knocks her newspaper to the ground. Jack picks it up and hands it to her. She says, 'Grazie.' He replies, 'Prego. You're welcome.' He remarks, 'Amidst gathering clouds.' She responds that he must assume she is English to speak of the weather, but she is Belgian, though educated at a boarding school in England, and is happy to discuss meteorology. A waiter approaches, flicks a cloth over the table, and asks what they would like. The woman orders a lemon juice, then looks at Jack, waiting. He orders a strawberry gelato. He introduces himself as Edward. She replies, 'Mathilde.' After a pause, she comments on the heat and that her car has no air conditioning. Jack asks what car they gave her, but she does not answer. He clears his throat and asks, 'Range?' She replies, 'One fifty to one seven five meters.' He asks about time, and she says five seconds, seven at most. He asks about targets—'One.' Fire rate—'Rapid.' Magazine capacity—'Large. Preferably 9mm Parabellum.' The waiter arrives with the drinks. She turns the glass of lemon juice in her fingers. She adds that the weapon must be light, compact, and possible to break down into parts. Jack asks how compact. She says a small vanity case would be acceptable. He says a small briefcase would be possible. He asks about X-rays and whether to camouflage it as a laptop, DVD player, MP3, or digital camera. She says it is not necessary. He asks about noise. She says a silencer. He replies there is no such thing, only a suppressor, which will dampen sound, dislocate the source, and reduce flash. It won't make her silent, but it will make her invisible, as the Finnish say—provided she accepts reduced range.

name: Jack and Mathilde Discuss Weapon Requirements at the Cafe
description: After exchanging names, Jack and Mathilde sit in silence for a moment before Mathilde comments on the heat and the lack of air conditioning in her car. She doesn’t answer when Jack asks what car she was given. Instead, she scans the crowd. Jack clears his throat and quietly asks, "Range?" Mathilde takes a long time to respond, speaking over the rim of her coffee cup while watching the people around them. "One fifty to one seven five meters," she says. Jack continues: "Time?" "Five seconds. Seven at the most," she replies. "Targets?" "One." "Fire rate?" "Rapid." "Magazine capacity?" "Large. Preferably 9mm Parabellum." The waiter arrives and sets down a glass of lemon juice in front of Mathilde and a raspberry ice cream in front of Jack. Mathilde twists the glass in her fingers and adds that the weapon must be light, compact, and capable of being broken down into parts. Jack asks how compact. She says a small vanity case would be acceptable. Jack replies that a small briefcase would be possible. He asks if she wants it disguised as an electronic device—laptop, DVD player, MP3 player, or digital camera. Mathilde isn’t sure if he’s serious. She says disguise isn’t necessary. Jack asks about noise. "Silencer," she says. Jack tells her there’s no such thing, only suppressors. It will reduce the sound, distort the source, and minimize flash, but it won’t make the weapon silent. He can make her invisible, as the Finnish say, but only if she’s willing to sacrifice some range. Mathilde doesn’t respond.
